name: precedence
description: -> is right-associative (a -> (b -> c)) and and binds tighter than or. A left-associative reading would violate impl_right_assoc at seq 2; reading or before and would never violate and_over_or.
source:
policy impl_right_assoc:
  always attr("a", 1) -> attr("b", 1) -> attr("c", 1)
policy and_over_or:
  always not (tool("x") or tool("y") and status("error"))
